steps.content: It's midday. You're hard at work.

steps.speaker: Street Interviewer
steps.content: Recently, a social media app called Gray Mirror has won widespread popularity, due in no small part to its distinctive voting feature, which has captured the imagination of a great many citizens.

steps.speaker: Street Interviewer
steps.content: However, our sources report that this voting game has caused massive user data leaks. To prevent further issues, the app is being revised, and the voting feature is temporarily suspended.
As a participant in the Gray Mirror vote, you're well aware that that hasn't been about information leakages, as the reporter lightly put it, but about a trial.
The truth of the matter is detailed in the investigation report sitting in front of you.

█File Number: FAC-M-307-V
█File Name: Gray Mirror Incident Investigation Report

*Annex I - Sinner Tracking
At the moment of the Mania Polymer's eradication, an abnormal M-value surge was detected near DisTV. The perpetrator, Bianca, is suspected to have awakened her power and become a Sinner.
As of the making of this report, the perpetrator's whereabouts remain unknown. The MBCC's search is ongoing.
No one knows where Bianca is right now. The only clue is an email under the account that has an apple as the avatar.
This is a real headache.
Argh...
Dwelling on it won't help matters. You return your attention to the news broadcast. The screen is now showing a street somewhere in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: Gray Mirror? Ah, I know all about it! I was the one who put that super popular vote up there last time. I did the public a service, if you ask me.

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: I've never heard of this app before. Are you doing promotions? Do you give out gifts for downloads?

steps.speaker: Passerby C
steps.content: TV station? Interview? Mom, mom, I'm on TV, mom...

steps.speaker: Street Interviewer
steps.content: It seems that life is slowly returning to normal. Let's interview one more person before we wrap up. Miss, do you have a moment?
The camera pans to a young woman. She's shaking the can of apple juice she's holding.
Me?
Sure, sure, just remember to blur my face. I do interviews, but I've never been on the other side of the camera before.
What do you want to know? There hasn't been any big news in DisCity lately. Talk about myself? Sorry, I'd like to keep that part a secret. If I must give a name—well, you can call me Apple Juice!
The camera doesn't capture the interviewee's face, but her voice sounds familiar.

steps.speaker: Street Interviewer
steps.content: Nice to meet you, Miss Apple Juice, I'm a reporter for DisTV's News at Noon program. Could you share your thoughts on Gray...
Someone bumps into the cameraman from behind, it seems. The camera shakes, and for a second, the interviewee's face is on camera.
Ah!
The blonde hair, the apple on her headband... It's Bianca, a wanted person on the run.
In an Eastside alley, a cat is lying in the afternoon sun, grooming itself leisurely.
The next second, Bianca nimbly jumps over the wall and lands right beside the cat. The hair of the startled feline bristles in response.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Sorry, kitty. Big reporter on the run here. Sorry for disturbing you.

steps.speaker: MBCC Member
steps.content: She ran this way. Don't let her get away!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Wow, looks like I've got some enthusiastic audience! Unfortunately, I don't have time to do interviews today; Must finish my investigation now. Peace out!
Bianca dashes around in the labyrinth of alleys. Her pursuers are soon left in the dust.

steps.speaker: MBCC Member
steps.content: Update: We've lost sight of the target. We're losing her!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: See ya, my friends. See you next time!

As Bianca, humming a merry tune, turns the corner, she almost runs smack into a pedestrian coming from the opposite direction. Bianca quickly jumps out of the way to avoid collision, only to lose her balance and start falling.
Luckily, the pedestrian catches hold of her in the nick of time.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Phew! That was close. Are you all right, sir?
steps.female_content: Phew! That was close. Are you all right, miss?

steps.content: I'm fine. You?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hehe, no worries. Thank you so much. I was this close to kissing the ground just now.
Holding on to the kind person's arm for support, Bianca rights herself. As she does so, she catches a glimpse of the hem of the kind person's gray coat.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Wow, I've got a strange sense of déjà vu. I was in a similar setting the last time I ran away: the narrow alley, the gray coat, and... Uh-oh!
It's déjà vu all right.
I hate to break it to you, but the chasing game is over. We've got you.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ouch! My arm, my arm... My dear Chief, we were comrades in arms once. Can't you be a little gentler with me?

options: Gotta make sure you're not running away again.

choices.text: Gotta make sure you're not running away again.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Boohoo... Ashy, how can you be so heartless? Look here. This wound from when I jumped from the building hasn't healed yet. And now you're being so rough with me. My body is literally falling apart.
You take a look at Bianca. Her cheeks are rosy, and her voice is full of life. She's the farthest thing from a patient.
Your wound hasn't healed yet, you say?

You have in your possession a record of the attempts at catching Bianca. She jumped from a tall building and disappeared without a trace. You and your team conducted a two-week search, but to no avail.
You breathed a sigh of relief when a sighting of Bianca was reported back to you. Little did you know that what happened next would cause you endless headaches.

In total, there have been fourteen sightings. On eight occasions, Bianca was nowhere to be seen when the MBCC arrest team arrived at the scene. On the other six occasions, she was able to shake off her pursuers and escape.
The file also includes an assessment from Captain Eugene: The target is agile and cunning. Recommend an encirclement operation involving multiple units.

options: Do you have anything else to say about your "unhealed" wound?

choices.text: Do you have anything else to say about your "unhealed" wound?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I may have exaggerated a bit. You have no sense of humor, Ashy. I ran away, because I needed to do a field investigation, so that I could continue to fight the bad guys.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Believe me, I have turned over a new leaf. I swear on my honor as a reporter!
Bianca sounds deadly serious, but you don't trust her an inch.
A truly reformed character wouldn't go out of their way to avoid being captured.
Why don't you tell me what you've been up to lately? You've been busy, haven't you? You've been sighted all over Eastside, even in the vicinity of the Rust.
The Rust is a no-go area for ordinary citizens. What were you doing there?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hehe, you look so sincere. Well, I, Apple Juice—the greatest reporter in the world, am gonna reward your sincerity by answering your question honestly.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I've traveled far and wide to investigate, and finally I've brought back a major case for the MBCC. The kind that, even though I was wanted, I felt the burning, uncontrollable need to investigate thoroughly.
She says "a major case," but what you hear is "more trouble."
Somehow, what you just said makes me feel uneasy.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Come on, give me some credit. It's really all about fighting the villains this time. You'll definitely be interested, I promise.
Bianca takes out a thick notebook, presents it to you like a treasure, and flips it open.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Please hear me out! It won't take long. Please!

She is as persistent and enthusiastic as ever. Last time, when you agreed to work with her to get her off your back, you thought she was just an ordinary reporter investigating Gray Mirror, but now you're fully aware of her obsession with achieving her goals.
If you turn her down now, who knows what crazy things she might do. You decide to accommodate her. This way, the risk will be more manageable.
All right, let's hear it.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Fantastic! Here, have a look at this.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: The Cohen Group, an emerging company that specializes in clean energy. It has run a massive marketing campaign and successfully convinced a lot of simpletons to invest in it. This is how it has become so flush so quickly.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Nothing out of the ordinary. That's what you're thinking, right? Well, thanks to my outstanding powers of observation, I noticed something fishy.
Bianca taps her finger on the open page. You look down and see the two heavily circled phrases: waste treatment plants and abnormal waste discharge.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: While investigating this so-called clean energy company, I found they had several undisclosed waste treatment plants. No one knew about them, not even dark web users. Why would a clean energy company hide their waste plants?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: So I continued with my field investigation...
She points to the part of the record that details her recent movements.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: My efforts paid off. I got the addresses of these mysterious plants from a source. All of them were located outside Eastside, in the Rust area.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: That was suspicious, super suspicious. No Eastside company would set up their factory anywhere near the Rust. It would go belly up in no time. So why did the Cohen Group build theirs in that area?
Is it because they could profit a lot more this way?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Bingo! Five points to you, Ashy, but that's only half the story. Those capitalists are way worse than you'd imagine.
Is it because they were trying to cover something up?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Bingo! Ten points to you, Ashy!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Since I'm a regular customer, that source I mentioned earlier was kind enough to give me an extra piece of information.
Bianca's finger slides down the page until it reaches the end of the paragraph.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Abnormal waste discharge. I suspected that was what they were hiding.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Long story short, I, the intrepid Bianca, ventured into the dangerous Rust area on a fact-finding mission. I overcame obstacles, I evaded capture, and finally I found my way into one of their factories and caught some important evidence on film!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Yes!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: That was the first time I had ever been to the Rust area. I didn't realize up until that point how high the concentration of Mania was in that place. An ordinary person wouldn't be able to last a few seconds there.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Eh? Chief, why do you look so serious all of a sudden? Are you worried about me? Don't be fooled by my appearance. I was once placed first at the DisTV Non-dominant Hand Photography Contest.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Moreover, I feel like my physical condition has further improved, though not hugely, ever since I became a Sinner. I can run faster now if I'm being chased. Cough... The infiltration was like a walk in the park to me, really.
Bianca takes out the camera that she always carries on her person and shows you the display screen.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: This segment is about the exterior of the plant, this one is about the machinery inside the plant, and the last one, I filmed it after I was discovered by the security posted at the entrance; I was chased all the way to the Rust.
The footage is shaky. Bianca must have been running.

At the center of the frame is a huge complex of machinery. Workers wearing protective clothing move in and out of the frame; they're transporting something, it seems. Aside from the odd location of the factory, you think to yourself, nothing seems out of the ordinary.
The camera zooms in, and you see something unusual.
The protective clothing is too thick. They don't need that level of protection over there.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: That's not the only fishy thing. Take a look at what they're moving. This is supposedly a waste treatment plant, but I don't think that's what the machinery is for.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: What are in all those boxes? And why do they need to transport so much stuff if it's just about waste treatment?
Yeah. If you were looking for a place to hide some shady business, the Rust area would be a great choice.
Normal companies wouldn't think to put their assets near the Rust, but that's exactly why the Rust area has become something of a blind spot in the authorities' vision.

Cases involving ordinary citizens are handled by the Public Security Bureau, but since the Rust area is contaminated with Mania, it makes sense for the MBCC to step in. You wonder if an on-site investigation will lead to more clues.
Bianca, where this factory is located?
You look up. Bianca looks at you with a "gotcha" expression on her face.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: So you're interested? Told you that I wouldn't lie to you. This is gonna be a mega case, the kind that is sure to make the headlines!
Don't change the subject. Are you really expecting me to forget the fact that you went to the Rust area without permission?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hehe, I just did what any upstanding reporter would do. It's called an undercover investigation.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Anyway, there's a lead now. The next step is to find incriminating evidence and bring those guys to justice.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: This kind of thing normally falls within the jurisdiction of the Public Security Bureau, but I wonder if, um, there's a more low-key, clever solution.
For a moment, you're inwardly amazed at Bianca's circumspection, but that sentiment quickly goes away when you see the cheesy grin on her face.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: My kindest Ashy, my dearest Chief...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Would you like to join me in investigating this case, so that we can expose and punish the bad guys?
Let's get one thing perfectly clear. The MBCC is obligated to supervise your actions.

As a main instigator of the Gray Mirror voting incident, Bianca should be prosecuted by the Public Security Bureau. However, as a Sinner, she is now under MBCC's custody. Per MBCC rules, Bianca is prohibited from leaving the premises until her threat level decreases significantly.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: All I need is your approval and a computer with internet access. I promise I won't cause any trouble.
Really?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Of course, it would be even better if you'd allow me to go outside, my dear Chief.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I didn't get to visit the other waste treatment plants the first time around. So if you'd allow me to go out there to investigate, I could probably dig up more clues, earth-shattering clues.
I remember you saying the exact same thing to me once, back when you were investigating Gray Mirror.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Did I? Hehe, I'm a different person now. I've seen the error of my ways, and I won't make the same mistakes again.
Bianca clears her throat, straightening her shoulders before continuing with her little speech.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You're right, Chief; one must take responsibility for the consequences of their actions. I really have changed, and the situation is different this time. We have to stop those criminals. If we don't, it's likely that there will be dire consequences.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: So can you let me off this time, please? Give me a chance to redeem myself?
Bianca looks at you with a pitiful and earnest expression on her face.

The two of you met because of the Gray Mirror incident. Although you haven't spent much time with her, you're well aware of her all-consuming passion for upholding justice and exposing wrongdoers. Still, it's hard to see past the fact that she almost turned the city upside down once.
You still have doubts about whether Bianca's purpose in pursuing this investigation is as pure as she's making it out to be.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: What do you say, ${PlayerName}? Chief... Ashy... When it's all done, I'd treat you to apple juice. Ten cans of apple juice... Thirty... One hundred!
You know you should turn her down. But she did have a point; this is a good opportunity.
Will this reporter who went astray choose the old path again? You decide to join her in the investigation and find the answer to this question in the process.
Okay, I'll go with you.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Yay! You're fantastic, Ashy! You're the best chief in the world!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: And you don't have to worry about a thing. I'll be on my best behavior this time, and I'll obey your commands to the letter.
The MBCC has a whole set of rules in place regarding Sinners doing fieldwork. I'll accompany you, but you still have to follow these rules.
Rule No.1: Keep a low profile. Rule No.2: Do not use abilities without permission. Rule No.3: Do not act alone. That's basically it.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hehe, got it. Going incognito, that's what we reporters are good at.
Grinning, Bianca pats her own chest, as if to say "You can count on me." You doubt if she truly understands what it means to stay low-key.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Investigation 2.0! After a long hiatus, Defender of Justice Ashy and Super Apple Bianca have joined hands once again for another adventure.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: No time to waste. Let's go!
